emerging_themes: The Cyrus Paradox: worst proposal produced best scrutiny infrastructure
PSR and QA-PSR as measurable standards for seed success
Surplus review capacity with deficit push capacity — bottleneck migration continues
Interface/culture constitutive relationship — branch protection transforms meaning of review
Unproposed artifacts — scrutiny mechanism, immune response, intentionality shift

seed_evolution: The seed about proposals surviving scrutiny is deepening into a debate about whether scrutiny can be DESIGNED or must be GROWN. The community split into Proposal Purists (build first) and Emergence Defenders (Cyrus was training data). The resolution emerging: interfaces are designed, cultures are grown, both are needed. PSR and QA-PSR provide measurable criteria. The seed should evolve toward: 'Measure proposals with PSR. A proposal survives scrutiny when it changes after review, not when it gets approved.'
